name: Hollowmere
tagline: A New England Halloween: a harvest festival, a witch trial reenactment, and a curse that's three hundred years old.
description: Every Halloween the little town of Hollowmere, Massachusetts, puts on its Harvest Festival: hayrides, cider, candlelit walking tours and, at midnight, a reenactment of the 1692 trial of Goody Abigail Thorne, the town's own witch. The festival chairman always plays the accused. This year, he didn't survive the part. A folk-horror Halloween mystery.
artStyle: New England folk horror, bare autumn trees, a white clapboard church, an old mill by a black pond, lantern light and falling leaves
